verdict.rationale: Payout reconciliation is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows agents can read balances and build cashflow reports through AgentOS and the CLI. Nothing documents balance-transaction or settlement data that links each bank deposit or payout back to its underlying charges. Reading balances and building cashflow reports are adjacent capabilities, not documented deposit-to-charge reconciliation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges
